records.description: Rejected by DTC-brand-only lenders (like Wayflyer) because they sell arbitrage goods. 103
records.logic: If Rev > $3k and Platform = Amazon, issues instant approval based on store data, not FICO. 103

records.title: The Q4 "Load Up" Capacity Calculator
records.description: Limited cash limits the volume of inventory a seller can front-load for Q4. 104
records.logic: Simulates 3-4 funding/restock cycles within the short Q4 window to show maximum capacity. 104

records.title: The "Deferred Transaction" Unlocker
records.description: Anger over Amazon labeling earned cash as "Deferred Transactions" in Seller Central. 105
records.logic: Dashboard Balance * 0.80 = Instantly Unlockable Amount within 4 hours. 105

records.title: The "Zombie Inventory" Detector
records.description: Aged inventory storage surcharges eating away at margins. 106
records.logic: Compares long-term holding cost against liquidating and reinvesting via OnRamp. 106

records.title: The "Payroll Panic" Countdown Timer
records.description: Waiting on Net-60 GC check while Friday payroll approaches, risking crew walk-off. 107, 108
records.logic: Current Balance / (Payroll * 1.18 / 5) = Days to Zero. Alerts if < Payment Date. 108

records.title: The "Bid Protector" Inflation Adjuster
records.description: Bidding jobs 3 months out while volatile material prices (copper/PVC) eat margins. 109
records.logic: Material Cost * (Inflation Factor * Duration). Outputs a Risk Buffer to add to the bid. 109

records.title: The "Net-90" Opportunity Cost Calculator
records.description: Thinking saving a 2% funding fee is better than getting cash early to bid new jobs. 110
records.logic: Annualized Cost of Waiting = (Potential Jobs Missed * Avg Profit) / Invoice Amount. 110 | Wait Cost = (Potential Jobs * Avg Profit) / Invoice Amount
records.output: Lost Profit Report 110 | "Lost Profit Recovery Plan" (Table)

records.title: The "Repair vs. Replace" ROI Engine
records.description: Semi-truck engine blows; emotional decision between a $25k rebuild or an $80k new truck. 111
records.logic: Calculates Cash Flow Difference between the Repair Path and Replace Path over 12 months. 111

records.title: The "Spot Market" Breakeven Calculator
records.description: Spot rates drop, truckers unsure of minimum Rate Per Mile (RPM) to cover insurance/fuel. 112
records.logic: Fixed CPM + Variable CPM + (Desired Profit / Miles) = Minimum Acceptable Target Rate. 112

records.title: The "Deal Killer" Hard Money Analyzer
records.description: Need to know instantly if 12% hard money interest kills a distressed property deal. 113
records.logic: Profit = ARV - (Loan + Interest + 3% Closing). If Profit > 15% ARV, Green Light. 113

records.title: The "Am I Bankable?" Probability Score
records.description: Terrified of rejection and hard credit inquiries ruining their score. 114
records.logic: Assigns 0-100 score filtering for Revenue >$15k, FICO >600, Time >1Yr. Routes to specific tiers. 114

records.title: The Section 179 "Tax Slash" Calculator
records.description: Hesitating on Q4 equipment purchases to reduce taxable income. 115
records.logic: Equipment Cost * Tax Bracket (assuming 100% depreciation) = Tax Savings / Net Cost. 115

records.title: The "Burn Rate" Runway Extender
records.description: Burning cash fast and needing to know the exact "Death Date" before missing payroll. 116
records.logic: Current Cash / (Monthly Expenses - Monthly Revenue) = Months of Runway Left. 116

records.title: The "Bad Debt" Consolidator
records.description: Crushed by daily deductions from multiple existing Merchant Cash Advances. 117
records.logic: Compares current daily burn (Payments * 22) against a new 24-month consolidation term. 117

records.title: The "Equity Defender" Simulator
records.description: Ignorance to the pain of venture capital dilution until Series C ruins their exit payout. 118
records.logic: Visualizes a side-by-side growth curve of VC equity bleed vs. a 0% equity-loss Moonshine route. 118

records.title: The "Bad Debt" Detector (MCA Killer)
records.description: Predatory MCA lenders disguise 100%+ APRs as simple "factor rates" in PDFs. 119
records.logic: OCR scans uploaded PDF offer, calculates the true APR, and flags "DANGER" or "SAFE". 119

records.title: The "Runway Extender" Dashboard
records.description: Fear of hitting zero cash; requires visual proof of how non-dilutive capital saves them. 120
records.logic: Connects to Plaid, analyzes burn rate, and visually pushes the "Death Date" out 6-12 months. 120

records.title: The "Deal Memo" Generator (AI Agent)
records.description: Hates writing extensive funding applications or executive summaries from scratch. 121
records.logic: Conversational AI asks 5-6 questions and formats answers into a banker-ready summary. 121

records.title: The "Recession-Proof" Stress Tester
records.description: Unaware of how vulnerable their cash flow is to macroeconomic shocks. 122
records.logic: AI scrapes user's URL and simulates 3 market crash scenarios tailored to their specific industry. 122

records.title: The "Compliance & KYC" Vault
records.description: Deal fatigue caused by messy corporate documents (EINs, Articles, Voided Checks). 123
records.logic: Users drop messy docs; system auto-verifies, renames, and packages them cleanly. 123

records.title: The "Investor Data Room" Template
records.description: Need a professional, secure data room to send financials to investors instantly. 124
records.logic: Generates a cloneable, password-protected Next.js template hosted on Vercel. 124

records.title: The "Link-in-Bio" Finance Deck
records.description: Standard PDF pitch decks look terrible and are unreadable on mobile devices. 125
records.logic: Form-to-site generator that builds a scrollable, mobile-optimized pitch page with a lock gate. 125

records.title: The "Fundability Score" Widget
records.description: B2B partners need a viral tool on their own site to capture leads for Moonshine. 125
records.logic: User inputs monthly revenue; widget generates a speedometer showing instant accessible capital. 125

records.title: The "Cost of Capital" Comparator
records.description: Demands radical transparency when comparing Moonshine vs VC vs MCA. 126
records.logic: Interactive table highlighting total payback amount and total equity lost across three routes. 126

records.title: The "Funding Simulator"
records.description: Needs a gamified way to visualize avoiding bankruptcy by adding credit lines. 127, 128
records.logic: Renders a "Runway Chart" crashing to zero; user toggles a $50k LOC to extend the green line. 128

records.title: The "Cash Command Center" Dashboard
records.description: Unaware of daily financial leaks, phantom subscriptions, and cash bleed. 129
records.logic: Plaid-connected n8n AI agent analyzes 30-day history and sends a daily "Savage Wake-Up Call". 129

records.title: The "Pitch Deck Roaster"
records.description: Terrified their pitch deck is boring or lacking critical financial metrics like CAC. 130
records.logic: OpenAI Vision scans slides as a "Wall Street Wolf" persona, giving specific, ruthless feedback. 130

records.title: The "Amazon DD+7 Survival Calculator"
records.description: Amazon's new DD+7 policy creates a 17-21 day cash flow gap that kills restocking. 131, 132
records.logic: Analyzes Monthly Sales + Avg Shipping Time to output the exact capital Amazon holds hostage. 132

records.title: The "Bankability Scorecard"
records.description: Banks auto-reject up to 92% of applications; users need an alternative "Einstein Predictor". 131, 132
records.logic: 6-question quiz calculates a surrogate FICO-SBSS score to bypass traditional gatekeepers. 132

records.title: The "Mentorship ROI Accelerator"
records.description: Coaches lose 30% of $10k mastermind sales because students lack upfront liquidity. 131, 132
records.logic: Shows how 0% credit stacking lets students pay $200/mo while using $10k for ad-spend fuel. 132

records.title: The TikTok Viral Curse Predictor
records.description: Predicts suspension risk (Late Dispatch Rate) during viral surges.
records.logic: Score = Cash / (Units Sold * Cost)

records.title: The "Section 179" Tax Slash Tool
records.description: Calculates Q4 tax savings of financing new equipment.
records.logic: Net Cost = Equipment Cost - (Cost * Tax Bracket)

records.title: The Gig Income Funding Predictor
records.description: Shows funding potential for drivers based on app activity.
records.logic: Max Funding = Avg Earnings * 4 (modified by seniority)

records.title: The "Runway Death Clock"
records.description: Agitates the fear of running out of cash before the next milestone.
records.logic: (Cash) / (Burn - (MRR * Growth)) to find the exact month cash hits $0.
records.output: The "Zero Hour" Dashboard: A giant red countdown clock showing the exact month and year they run out of money.

records.title: The "CAC Payback Analyzer"
records.description: Tests if their marketing engine is bankable.
records.logic: CAC = Spend/Customers. Payback = CAC / (ARPU * Margin). Evaluates if < 6 months.
records.output: The "Bankability Scale" PDF: A visual dial (Red/Yellow/Green) scoring their capital efficiency.

records.title: The Term Sheet "Toxicity"
records.description: Scanner. Educates founders on predatory VC terms.
records.logic: Assigns a negative multiplier to the founder's exit value for every toxic term selected.
records.output: The "Toxicity Score" Checklist: A graded report (A to F) showing how predatory their current term sheet is.

records.title: The "Trapped Cash" Calculator
records.description: Agitates the pain of Net 60/90 invoice delays.
records.logic: (Invoiced Volume / 30) * Days to Pay. Calculates working capital deficit.
records.output: The "Missing Millions" Report: A bar chart showing how much of their cash is trapped in AR.

records.title: The Fundability Scorecard
records.description: The ultimate self-qualification tool for your ecosystem.
records.logic: Weighted scoring matrix. >80 = Prime, 50-79 = Incubator, <50 = Unfundable.
records.output: The "Lender's Eye" Score: A personalized teardown of the metrics keeping them from getting funded.

records.title: The Debt vs. Equity Showdown
records.description: A direct comparison tool for growth rounds.
records.logic: Compares (Exit Val * VC Dilution) against (Exit Val - Principal - Interest).
records.output: The "Net Wealth" Chart: A side-by-side bar chart of their take-home pay at exit.

records.title: The SaaS LTV:CAC Diagnostic
records.description: Finds the golden gooses who don't realize they are golden.
records.logic: LTV = ARPU / Churn. Divides LTV by CAC. Checks if ratio is > 3:1.
records.output: The "Growth Engine" Gauge: Visualizes if their business is a leaky bucket or a compounding asset.

records.title: The "Cost of a Board Seat"
records.description: EstimatorQuantifies the hidden, non-financial cost of VC.
records.logic: (Founder Rate * Prep Hours * 12) + (Fees * 12). Calculates wasted resources.
records.output: The "Boss Tax" Invoice: A fake, customized invoice showing what they pay annually just to manage their VC board.

records.title: The True APR Revealer
records.description: Exposes predatory lenders by calculating effective APR.
records.logic: Converts hidden fees and warrants into an annualized percentage rate.
records.output: The "Unmasked Rate" Summary: Shows the delta between the "advertised" rate and the real mathematical rate.

records.title: The Exit Waterfall Simulator
records.description: Shows who gets paid first when the company sells.
records.logic: subtracts debt, subtracts preferred return, then allocates the remaining common pool.
records.output: The "Waterfall" Diagram: A step-by-step visual of the cash trickling down (or drying up before it hits the founder).
